admission.justification: Role matrix and containment checks prevent worker authority escalation or a manager starting work under another master.

conditions: A repeated request retains the recorded starter and request identity.
The earlier system-specialist read spelling canonicalizes to Investigator; it creates no second role.
exclusions: Developer dashboard selection is not an agent may-start-table call.
statement: Who may start what is decided from the caller’s binding: an Architect may start every native role except Architect; an Orchestrator may start Manager, Worker, Reviewer, Curator and Investigator only under its own sprint; a Manager may start Worker, Reviewer, Curator and Investigator only under its own master and sprint; Worker, Reviewer, Curator and Investigator start none. Investigator accepts Projects, sprint or sprint/master selections and refuses a leaf before launch; anything else is refused with the rule in words.
